Section 5

Workflows

How the work moves through the platform, and how each piece hands off to the next.

How the pieces fit together

The workflows are not separate systems. They pass work to each other through the same records:

  • Joining creates a node on the family tree, and the member appears in the directory under the choices they made (D30).
  • Standing gates everything with a franchise or a prize: ballots, awards and committee seats read the same standing, computed from payments.
  • A life event flows outward. A birth, a marriage or a death is declared, the tree committee reviews it, and it reaches the household, the magazine and any change in dues. The platform offers those changes and never makes them on its own.
  • A programme's top rung invites the next programme, but only on the two ladder branches, Education and Leadership (D39).
  • The remittance ledger gates the Convention. A delegate's credentials are checked against what their club has remitted, not against what anyone says.
  • Every payment goes through one door, whichever workflow takes it.
